legend: The Mongolian Death Worm (Gobi Desert, Mongolia, nomad legend)
lines: Deep in the Gobi Desert, nomads whisper of a worm that hides beneath the sand.
They call it the olgoi-khorkhoi, the large intestine worm.
Legend says it is red as blood, and as long as a man's arm.
It sleeps underground, and only appears after summer rain.
They say it spits yellow poison, and can shock from a distance.
In the nineteen twenties, an American explorer wrote down the tale.
Expeditions have searched the dunes for years, and found nothing.
Yet herders still avoid the sand after rain.
Would you cross the dunes tonight?
title: The Desert Worm That Shocks From a Distance #shorts
description:
Mongolian nomads tell of a red worm that hides in the Gobi sand and spits poison after rain. No one has ever found one. Real or myth?
